---
title: "Country Flags"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(tidyverse)
library(countrycode)

# List all flag files and map codes to country names
files <- list.files("data", pattern = "\\.png$")
codes <- sub("\\.png$", "", files)

flag_data <- tibble(
  code = codes,
  name = countrycode(
    toupper(codes),
    origin = "iso2c",
    destination = "country.name",
    custom_match = c(
      "GB-ENG" = "England",
      "GB-NIR" = "Northern Ireland",
      "GB-SCT" = "Scotland",
      "GB-WLS" = "Wales",
      "XK" = "Kosovo"
    )
  )
) |>
  drop_na(name) |>
  arrange(name)

# Pass the data to Observable JS
ojs_define(flag_data = flag_data)
```

```{ojs}
// Transform columnar data into an array of objects
flags = transpose(flag_data)

// Dropdown input to select a country
viewof selected = Inputs.select(flags, {
  label: "Select a country:",
  format: d => d.name
})

// Display the selected flag image
html`<div style="margin-top: 20px;">
  <img src="data/${selected.code}.png" alt="${selected.name}" style="max-width: 400px; border: 1px solid #ccc; border-radius: 4px;" />
</div>`
```
